name: smith incline reverse-grip press
description: On an incline bench, you press the smith machine bar with a reverse grip. Works the upper chest and triceps.
instructions: Set an incline bench in the smith machine so the bar lines up with your upper chest.
Lie back and grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest, elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
